Definition: The number the paper prints against the entry, 1-92, in printed order. This is the key that TABLE 1 prints in parentheses inside its data cells and inside its footnotes j-y.
Note: One row per printed number; the printed list numbers every entry individually, so there are no ranges to expand.
Source Note: Printed REFERENCES list, Am J Physiol 241: R211-R212 (PDF pages 10-11).

Definition: The bibliography entry exactly as printed, including the paper's own typographic errors. Three are known and are NOT corrected: ref 1 'Anatomie cómparée' (for comparée), ref 41 'oxygen untake' (for uptake), ref 48 'Oberflächeroregel' (for Oberflächenregel).
Note: Verbatim transcription; hyphens and en dashes in page ranges are normalised to a plain hyphen, which is the only character-level change made.
Source Note: Printed REFERENCES list, Am J Physiol 241: R211-R212 (PDF pages 10-11).

Definition: Publication year, parsed in the build script as the last four-digit year in the citation string. Range 1878-1978.
Note: Derived, not a separate printed field. Checked in the build against the last four-digit run anywhere in the string: 0 disagreements across 92 rows.
Source Note: Printed REFERENCES list, Am J Physiol 241: R211-R212 (PDF pages 10-11).

Definition: One row per printed numbered bibliography entry (92). This item carries no measurements, no species and no traits; it exists so that the per-cell citations of Mink_etal_1981_TABLE1 can be resolved to a source.
Source Note: Printed REFERENCES list, Am J Physiol 241: R211-R212 (PDF pages 10-11).

Definition: secondary. A bibliography holds no data of its own. It is the lookup layer for TABLE 1's per-row provenance and is excluded from every merge.
Note: Proposed for the registry 'Data role' column; see Mink_etal_1981_REFERENCES_registry_row.xlsx.
Source Note: Printed REFERENCES list, Am J Physiol 241: R211-R212 (PDF pages 10-11).

Definition: Mink_etal_1981_TABLE1.R reads this item's CSV and writes reference_tables/Mink_etal_1981_TABLE1_references.csv, the item-scoped subset: one row per reference number TABLE 1 actually cites, with cited_in_column naming every TABLE 1 column (and footnote) the key appears in. 54 of the 92 entries are cited by TABLE 1; the other 38 are cited elsewhere in the paper (text, METHODS or figures - not checked entry by entry) and are deliberately absent from the item-scoped lookup.
Note: Build order matters: this item must be built before Mink_etal_1981_TABLE1.
Source Note: Printed REFERENCES list and TABLE 1, Am J Physiol 241: R208-R212.
